items.exampleEn: Our class has many lively students.
items.exampleZh: 我們班有很多活潑的學生。

items.exampleEn: The little boy was frightened of the dark.
The students looked bored in class.
items.exampleZh: 學生們上課時看起來很無聊。

items.exampleEn: The cat lay on the sofa, warm and relaxed.
items.exampleZh: 貓躺在沙發上，暖呼呼又很放鬆。

items.exampleEn: I felt uneasy when the man followed me.
items.exampleZh: 那個男人跟著我的時候，我覺得很不安。

items.exampleEn: It's a pity that the rain stopped our game.
items.exampleZh: 下雨讓我們的比賽停了，真可惜。

items.exampleEn: The ending of the book was disappointing.
items.exampleZh: 這本書的結局令人失望。

items.sentenceEn: What a pity you can't come to the party!
items.sentenceZh: 你不能來參加派對，真可惜！

items.audioEn: I was bored, so I went for a walk by the river.
items.audioZh: 我覺得很無聊，所以去河邊散步。
items.questionZh: 說話的人覺得無聊時做了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: I always feel relaxed at the seaside.
items.sentenceZh: 我在海邊總是覺得很放鬆。

items.sentenceEn: The night market is lively and noisy.

items.stemEn: The hotel was dirty and noisy. Our stay was very ____.
items.stemZh: 飯店又髒又吵，這次住宿非常令人失望。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I went to the night market with my cousin. It was lively and full of people. At first, my cousin looked uneasy because there were so many people. Then she was frightened when she saw a man with a big snake. "Snakes terrify me," she said. After we ate some hot soup, she finally felt relaxed. The famous cake shop was closed. What a pity! But the evening was not disappointing at all.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我和我的表親去逛夜市。夜市很熱鬧，人擠人。一開始，我的表親因為人太多看起來很不自在。後來她看到一個男人帶著一條大蛇，嚇了一大跳。她說：「我超怕蛇的。」喝了熱湯之後，她終於放鬆下來。那家有名的蛋糕店沒開，真可惜！不過這個晚上一點也不令人失望。

questions.questionZh: 作者的表親一開始為什麼不自在？

rubricZh: 「覺得無聊」用 bored（形容人的感受）
讓人覺得無聊的事物用 boring

items.promptZh: 我爸爸退休以後看起來輕鬆多了。
referenceEn: My father looks much more relaxed since he retired.
Since he retired, my dad looks a lot more relaxed.
rubricZh: 用 relaxed 表示「輕鬆的」（例如 looks more relaxed）
「多了」可寫，例如 much more relaxed、a lot more relaxed 等
「退休以後」可寫，例如 since he retired 等；寫 looked … after he retired 也正確
